# Sightline

> Sightline is a screenshot app, screen recorder and screencast editor for Mac, with a built in MCP server and CLI so AI agents like Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex can take screenshots, record the screen and annotate on your Mac. Capture anything from the menu bar, polish it in an image and video editor, and keep everything on the Mac, with no account.

Sightline replaces the macOS screenshot tool (⌘⇧3, ⌘⇧4, ⌘⇧5) and adds a screenshot editor, scrolling screenshots, text recognition (OCR), pins, a history, screen recording with sound and voice, a video editor for screencasts and an MCP integration for AI coding agents. It is sold in the Mac App Store and available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese.

## Links

- [Website](https://sightlinemac.com/): features, videos and FAQ

- [Privacy policy](https://sightlinemac.com/privacy.html)

## Screenshots and the screenshot editor

- Area, window, full screen and scrolling screenshots with the familiar macOS shortcuts, a magnifier, a timer and a floating thumbnail. Scrolling capture shows a live preview of the stitched page. Press F while selecting an area to freeze the screen, so open menus, tooltips and hover states stay in the screenshot; a setting freezes every area selection.
- History of every capture, searchable by the text inside screenshots (read on the Mac into a private index, the files stay untouched), with a snippet of the match, favorites and filters for screenshots, recordings and favorites.
- Screenshot editor to annotate screenshots: arrows, lines, shapes, text in five fonts with an optional background box, highlights, step numbers, magnify, pen, blur and pixelate, each on a single key. Crop, rotate, flip and resize a screenshot, and export it as PNG, JPEG or WebP.
- Beautify: put a screenshot on a background with padding, rounded corners and a shadow; save looks as presets or let Apple Intelligence suggest some.
- Capture Text reads the text on screen (OCR) and copies it. A color picker copies any color on screen.
- Remove Background, pins that float above other windows, and detection of passwords and keys before you share.
- Show Differences: pin a design or an earlier capture over the running app and Sightline numbers every spot that differs, with a hint whether it moved, is missing or only looks different. Tracing lets clicks reach the app below while the marks follow.

## Screen recording and screencasts

- Screen recorder for Mac: record the screen, a window or an area with system sound and your voice from the microphone, after an optional countdown.
- Replay keeps the last 15 seconds of the screen, so you can save what just happened.
- Video editor for screencasts with a timeline: split, trim and reorder clips, play parts at 0.5x to 15x, a sound lane to mute or change the volume up to 400 %, smooth or instant zooms, Zoom on Clicks with zooms that can follow the pointer or the content, click highlights and a larger pointer, marks with their own timing, and blurs that follow moving content.
- Export recordings at the original size, 1080p or 720p, as MP4 or MOV, in high, medium or small quality, or as a looping GIF without sound (For Chat 640 px at 10 fps, For Docs 960 px at 15 fps, or your own width and frame rate).
- Saved screenshots and recordings stay editable when opened again.

## MCP integration for AI agents

- Sightline has a built in MCP server. AI agents use it to capture the screen, read text, find earlier captures, annotate, record and edit screencasts, and check their own UI work against a design.
- Connect: in Sightline, open Settings > AI Agents, turn on agent access and click Connect for Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex. Any other MCP client works by running `/Applications/Sightline.app/Contents/MacOS/sightline-cli mcp` as a stdio server. Each agent asks for permission the first time.
- Command line (CLI): `sightline-cli tools` lists the tools; `sightline-cli <tool> --json '{...}'` calls one and prints JSON.

### MCP tools

- `capture_screen`, `capture_area`, `capture_window`, `capture_scrolling`: take screenshots of a display, an area, a window or a whole scrolling page.
- `list_windows`, `list_displays`: find what can be captured.
- `capture_text`, `find_text`: read the text on screen (OCR) or find where a word is.
- `pick_color`: read the color at a point.
- `annotate`: draw arrows, boxes, text, highlights, step numbers and blurs on a screenshot or recording; crop, rotate, flip, resize and export; cut, speed up and zoom recordings, also on every click, and export them as MP4, MOV or GIF.
- `beautify`, `list_looks`, `save_look`: put a screenshot on a background, list or save looks.
- `open_in_editor`, `copy_to_clipboard`: hand the result to the user.
- `record_screen`, `last_recording`, `inspect_recording`, `save_replay`: record the screen, find and inspect recordings, save the last seconds.
- `last_screenshot`: the newest screenshot.
- `search_captures`: search the user's screenshots and recordings by file name and by the text inside screenshots, like History, with a snippet of the match and favorites.
- `compare_with_design`: compare the screen with a design image and list what differs.

## Privacy

- No account, no analytics and nothing sent to the developer. Screenshots, recordings and recognized text stay on the Mac.
- Agent access is off until you turn it on, each agent asks first, and agents only read and write inside the screenshot folder.
